definitions.explanation: A hand game played between two or more people using three hand shapes: rock (fist), paper (flat hand), and scissors (two fingers extended). Rock beats scissors, scissors beats paper, and paper beats rock.

examples.japanese: じゃんけん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めよう→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's decide the order with rock-paper-scissors.

examples.japanese: じゃんけん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦{当番|とうばん}→当番：04564_touban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I lost at rock-paper-scissors, so I became the cleaning duty person.

examples.japanese: ⟦じゃんけんぽん→じゃんけんぽん：noentry⟧！⟦あいこ→あいこ：22655_aiko⟧⟦でしょ→でしょう：09887_deshou⟧！
examples.english: Rock, paper, scissors, shoot! It's a tie!
examples.notes: The standard chant used when playing

notes:
THE THREE HANDS:
・⟦グー→グー：noentry⟧ (rock/fist) - beats ⟦チョキ→チョキ：noentry⟧
・⟦チョキ→チョキ：noentry⟧ (scissors/peace sign) - beats ⟦パー→パー：noentry⟧
・⟦パー→パー：noentry⟧ (paper/flat hand) - beats ⟦グー→グー：noentry⟧

PLAYING PHRASES:
・⟦じゃんけんぽん→じゃんけんぽん：noentry⟧！ (Rock, paper, scissors, shoot!)
・⟦あいこ→あいこ：22655_aiko⟧⟦でしょ→でしょう：09887_deshou⟧！ (It's a tie! - said when replaying after a draw)
・⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦グー→グー：noentry⟧！ (First is rock! - optional starting phrase)

COMMON USES IN JAPAN:
・Deciding who goes first in games
・Settling disputes fairly among friends
・Choosing who pays for a meal (⟦{割|わ}り{勘|かん}→割り勘：08156_warikan⟧ situations)
・Children's games and classroom activities

VARIATIONS:
・⟦{後出|あとだ}し→後出し：noentry⟧じゃんけん (delayed rock-paper-scissors - cheating)
・⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧じゃんけん (continuous/tournament style)

COLLOCATIONS:
・じゃんけん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ (to decide by rock-paper-scissors)
・じゃんけん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧ (to win at rock-paper-scissors)
・じゃんけん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧ (to lose at rock-paper-scissors)
・じゃんけん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to play rock-paper-scissors)
